themes.title: Oil & Gas - gas economy (CGD/LNG) + refining/upstream
themes.need: India's gas-economy push now collides with an outright policy reversal. ATGL grew volume 13% to 303 MMSCM and revenue 27% to INR 1,908cr, yet EBITDA FELL sequentially to INR 281cr (~14.7% margin, from INR 310cr) because the government withdrew the pooled-gas mechanism after the West Asia 'peace deal', pushing ATGL to ~15% spot volumes with Brent above $107/bbl; management also noted NWG price is 12% of the Indian crude basket, so a 62% domestic mix protects far less than it looks, and CNG station adds slowed to +5 from +25 in Q4 even as CNG demand grows ~30%. The same shock ran the other way for integrated refining: RELIANCE delivered O2C EBITDA of INR 17,000cr (+17%) THROUGH the Strait-of-Hormuz closure at 96-97% throughput while Asian peers ran 15-20% below capacity, with ethane+ROGC at ~70% of ethylene feed as distillate cracks blew out (gas oil $16 to $63, ATF $14 to $62). MGL/GUJGASLTD/IGL/IRMENERGY carry the same CGD margin squeeze; PETRONET/OIL/ONGC/IOC ride LNG-infra + domestic-gas; CHENNPETRO/MRPL ride GRM cracks; DEEPINDS/JINDRILL/SEAMECLTD on ONGC E&P capex; AEGISLOG/AEGISVOPAK add LPG/gas terminalling.
themes.driver: Whether the pooled/APM gas-allocation mechanism is restored (the single biggest CGD earnings variable); LNG spot price and Brent; GRM/distillate cracks; ONGC rig tenders & day-rates.

hero.oneLiner: The deck positions Antelopus Selan Energy (formerly Selan Exploration Technology) as an onshore India E&P operator running phased appraisal-and-development drilling campaigns across Cambay basin fields (Bakrol, Karjisan, Cambay, Lohar, Dangeru) plus Assam's Duarmara, with production growth driven by infill drilling, fracs and newly won DSF licenses.

business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- Portfolio described as largely 100% participating-interest onshore blocks: Bakrol (100% PI), Lohar (100% PI), Karjisan (100% PI) and Dangeru (100% PI), with Cambay held at 50% PI.
- The deck frames the assets as under-drilled: 'Even post Phase 2, large portion of the Block remains undrilled, implying a potential to increase well density across the acreage' (Bakrol).
- Won 2 'highly contested' onshore licenses in DSF Bid Round IV, in Cambay & KG basin, with formal award awaited.
- Cambay field is described as a legacy field with 'production behaviour over the last 30+ years' across a 161 Sq. Km area, being re-mapped across three zones (MBS/Miocene, OS-II/Oligocene, EP-IV/Eocene).

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)
capital_allocation.body:
- In June 2026 the company obtained a credit rating of IND A / Stable / IND A1 from India Ratings.
- Commissioner (Appeals) allowed the company's refund claim for excess Cess paid in FY21-FY23 of c. Rs 6.56 Cr, earlier expensed, to be recognised upon receipt of the final order.

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Name change] The issuer is Antelopus Selan Energy Limited, formerly known as Selan Exploration Technology Limited (CIN L74899HR1985PLC113196), registered in Gurgaon, Haryana.
- [Gross vs PI] The Cambay field page reports 'Gross Sales (boepd)' of 130 for Q1 FY'27 (118 in Q4 FY'26) while the consolidated sales table shows Cambay at 65 boepd on a 50% PI basis - the deck's two labels are different measures.
- [Committed work programs] Cambay carries a committed work program under the extension FDP and farm-in agreement of drilling 3 wells and reviving sick wells wherever feasible; Duarmara had 2 wells committed under the agreed RSC work program and farm-in agreement.
- [Inventory timing] The deck calls the custody-transfer shortfall 'A once-a-year timing issue, which will normalize next quarter'.
